simple.meaning: עָנָן (ʻânân) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a cloud (as covering the sky), i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 9:13. The surrounding context includes covenant, Israel.

definitions.short: a cloud (as covering the sky), i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud

On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.
Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
